dasha.plTableHint: Select any period in the list to see its sub-periods here. As in Parashara's Light, periods that ended before the chart moment have no dates.
settings.intro: These follow the chart's profile ({profile}) unless you change them here. A change applies to every chart in this browser until you reset it.
settings.ayanamsa.hint: Parashara's Light's eight options, decoded from its program. Lahiri is PL's default.
settings.deltaT.hint: Moves the Moon by about half an arcsecond per second of Delta-T. Other planets are hardly affected.
settings.node.hint: PL uses the true node unless changed in its options.
settings.dashaYear.hint: Length of one dasha year. PL's "365.25" option really uses 365.2421875 days.
settings.theme.hint: Warm night is gentler on the eyes in the evening.
settings.text.hint: Enlarges all text and tables. Charts grow with the window.

vargas.grade.open: Placeholder: equal to the alternate D11 until the Iyer rule is supplied.
vargas.boundary: A planet exactly on an amsa boundary belongs to the amsa that begins there.

jai.exception.bphs: BPHS: in the house → 10th, in the 7th → 4th
jai.arudhaNote: AL is the arudha lagna (A1); UL, the upapada, is in {ul}. Which exception rule Parashara's Light applies is not yet confirmed.
jai.kmNote: Navamsha chart with the Atma karaka's navamsha sign ({sign}, {ak}) as the ascendant.
jai.drishtiNote: Movable signs aspect the fixed signs except the one next to them, and vice versa; dual signs aspect each other.

yogi.note: The Yogi point is Sun + Moon + 93°20′, as Parashara's Light computes it. Its Avayogi and Duplicate Yogi conventions are not yet confirmed on a PL printout.
